task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the tomato from the counter (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the mug on the counter near the coffee machine (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the tomato on a plate on the counter (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the coffee pot and place it near the mug (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Arrange the lettuce and tomato attractively on the plate (r1_s6)
plans.R2:
Based on the images of the living room, here's a plan to make the space welcoming for the guest:

[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs closer to the coffee table to create a cozy seating area. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Pickup the box from the coffee table and place it on the side table to clear space. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Pickup the vase from the coffee table and place it in the center for decoration. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Ensure the sofa cushions are neatly arranged for comfort. (r2_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Move the chair near the TV to the seating area for additional seating. (r2_s5)
- R2 [LOCAL] Adjust the lighting by turning on the lamp for a warm ambiance. (r2_s6)

This plan uses the available objects and capabilities to create a welcoming environment for the guest.
plans.R3:
Based on the images, here's a plan for preparing the room:

[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the pillow from the bed and place it neatly to make the bed look inviting. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the teddy bear from the floor and place it on the bed for a cozy touch. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the book from the dresser and place it on the bed for the guest to read. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the small decorative item from the dresser and place it on the bedside table for added decor. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the lamp from the bedside table and turn it on to create a warm atmosphere. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the small dish from the dresser and place it on the bedside table to offer as a snack dish. (r3_s6)
